req.title: Reject player with duplicate squadNumber
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 409 Conflict when the squadNumber in a new player already belongs to another player.

doc.reasoning: R-PLAYER-008 requires HTTP 409 Conflict when a POST /players/ request carries a squadNumber already present in the database. The test suite covers: (1) a positive case confirming a brand-new squadNumber is accepted with HTTP 201; (2) a negative/EP case confirming an existing squadNumber (squad 10 – Messi, pre-loaded) returns exactly HTTP 409 with the correct detail message; (3) a boundary/STC case that first creates a player with a fresh squadNumber, then immediately POSTs a second player with the same number to confirm the 409 path is triggered by the state transition from 'absent' to 'present'; (4) a DT case covering the decision table row where all fields are valid but squadNumber collides; (5) a BVA case using squadNumber=1 (lowest pre-loaded value) to confirm the boundary of the uniqueness check. Each test imports the FastAPI app in-process and uses TestClient, asserts exact status codes and response body fields, and is fully self-contained.

tests.name: test_post_player_new_squad_number_returns_201
preconditions: Database is pre-loaded with 26 rows; squadNumber 99 does not exist
actions: POST /players/ with a valid payload using squadNumber=99
trace: R-PLAYER-008 – happy path: unique squadNumber must be accepted
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)

def test_post_player_new_squad_number_returns_201():
    payload = {
        "firstName": "Test",
        "lastName": "Player",
        "squadNumber": 99,
        "position": "Goalkeeper"
    }
    r = client.post("/players/", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 201
    body = r.json()
    assert body["squadNumber"] == 99
    assert "id" in body
    assert body["firstName"] == "Test"
    assert body["lastName"] == "Player"
    assert body["position"] == "Goalkeeper"

tests.name: test_post_player_duplicate_squad_number_returns_409
preconditions: Database is pre-loaded with 26 rows; squadNumber 10 belongs to Lionel Messi
actions: POST /players/ with a valid payload using squadNumber=10 (already taken)
expected: Response detail contains 'A Player with this squad number already exists.'
trace: R-PLAYER-008 – error pathway: duplicate squadNumber must yield 409
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)

def test_post_player_duplicate_squad_number_returns_409():
    payload = {
        "firstName": "Duplicate",
        "lastName": "Player",
        "squadNumber": 10,
        "position": "Right Winger"
    }
    r = client.post("/players/", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 409
    body = r.json()
    assert body["detail"] == "A Player with this squad number already exists."

tests.name: test_post_player_duplicate_after_create_returns_409
preconditions: Database is pre-loaded with 26 rows; squadNumber 50 does not exist
expected: Second POST returns HTTP 409 with exact detail message
trace: R-PLAYER-008 – state transition: absent -> present triggers 409 on repeat
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)

def test_post_player_duplicate_after_create_returns_409():
    payload = {
        "firstName": "State",
        "lastName": "Transition",
        "squadNumber": 50,
        "position": "Centre-Back"
    }
    r1 = client.post("/players/", json=payload)
    assert r1.status_code == 201
    body1 = r1.json()
    assert body1["squadNumber"] == 50

    r2 = client.post("/players/", json=payload)
    assert r2.status_code == 409
    body2 = r2.json()
    assert body2["detail"] == "A Player with this squad number already exists."

tests.name: test_post_player_decision_table_all_valid_fields_duplicate_squad
preconditions: Database is pre-loaded with 26 rows; squadNumber 10 belongs to Messi
actions: POST /players/ with all optional fields populated and squadNumber=10
expected: HTTP 409 Conflict regardless of other field values
Response body detail equals 'A Player with this squad number already exists.'
No Location header present in response
trace: R-PLAYER-008 – DT: fully-populated valid body with duplicate squadNumber must still yield 409
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)

def test_post_player_decision_table_all_valid_fields_duplicate_squad():
    payload = {
        "firstName": "Full",
        "middleName": "Middle",
        "lastName": "Body",
        "dateOfBirth": "1990-01-01T00:00:00.000Z",
        "squadNumber": 10,
        "position": "Right Winger",
        "abbrPosition": "RW",
        "team": "Some Team",
        "league": "Some League",
        "starting11": True
    }
    r = client.post("/players/", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 409
    body = r.json()
    assert body["detail"] == "A Player with this squad number already exists."
    assert "Location" not in r.headers

        "firstName": "Adjacent",

        "squadNumber": 27,
